author: HotAndCrunch
body:
What I was thinking is that every week, teams play matches (not scrims) against each other, to gain points in a league table. after every 2 - 3 months, the winners / runner ups will be given a prize and the points will reset. these matches will be hosted on avicus servers, not private home hosted servers.



What do you think?
